criteria: Adjustment of Outstanding Expenses and Prepaid Expenses in respective nominal accounts and Balance Sheet.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Outstanding expenses added to respective expense and shown as a liability; prepaid expenses deducted and shown as an asset.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct adjustment made in the Profit and Loss Account or Trading Account but omitted from the Balance Sheet.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: No adjustments made for outstanding or prepaid items.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Adjustment of Accrued Income and Income Received in Advance in financial statements.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accrued income added to income and shown as an asset; unearned income deducted from income and shown as a liability.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct adjustment in P&L account only or Balance Sheet only.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Failed to apply accrual concept adjustments.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Calculation and recording of Depreciation on fixed assets in Profit and Loss Account and deduction from asset value in Balance Sheet.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Depreciation correctly computed, debited to P&L, and deducted from the respective asset in the Balance Sheet.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Depreciation debited to P&L but not deducted from asset, or calculation error.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Depreciation completely ignored.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Treatment of further bad debts and creation/adjustment of provision for doubtful debts and provision for discount on debtors.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Further bad debts deducted from debtors and added to bad debts in P&L, followed by accurate calculation of new provision.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct bad debts adjustment but incorrect formula or sequence for provision for doubtful debts.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Failure to adjust bad debts and provisions against debtors.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Proper grouping and marshalling of assets and liabilities in the Balance Sheet in order of liquidity or permanence.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: All assets and liabilities correctly classified into fixed/current/non-current and presented in standard order with totals matching.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Most items classified correctly with minor misplacements or minor mismatch in totals.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Assets and liabilities placed randomly without logical grouping or standard order.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Computation and recording of Manager's Commission before and after charging such commission.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Commission accurately calculated using correct formula (before/after) and shown as an expense and outstanding liability.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Formula misapplied (e.g., using 'before' formula for 'after' condition) but correct accounting entry passed.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Manager's commission completely omitted.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Comprehensive preparation of complete financial statements (Trading A/c, P&L A/c, and Balance Sheet) with multiple adjustments.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: All statements prepared accurately with all adjustments fully accounted for and Balance Sheet tallies.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Trading and P&L correctly prepared, but Balance Sheet fails to tally due to minor transfer or listing error.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Major conceptual errors, incomplete statements, or complete failure to account for adjustments.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Correct treatment of closing stock appearing outside or inside the trial balance in Trading Account and Balance Sheet.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Shown on the credit side of Trading Account and asset side of Balance Sheet if outside trial balance; only on the asset side if inside trial balance.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Shown in only one place or placed on the incorrect side.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Completely omitted or incorrectly treated as an expense/income.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Correct adjustment of outstanding expenses in Profit & Loss Account and Balance Sheet.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Added to the respective expense in Profit & Loss Account (or Trading Account) and shown as a current liability in the Balance Sheet.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Adjustment made in only one statement or incorrect addition/subtraction.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: No adjustment made for outstanding expenses.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Correct adjustment of prepaid or unexpired expenses in Profit & Loss Account and Balance Sheet.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Deducted from the respective expense in Profit & Loss Account and shown as a current asset in the Balance Sheet.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Adjustment done in only one statement or treated as a liability instead of an asset.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: No effect given to prepaid expenses.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Correct treatment of accrued income (income earned but not received) in Profit & Loss Account and Balance Sheet.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Added to the respective income on the credit side of Profit & Loss Account and shown as a current asset in the Balance Sheet.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Included in only one statement or incorrect arithmetic calculation.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Accrued income omitted completely.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Correct treatment of income received in advance (unearned income) in Profit & Loss Account and Balance Sheet.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Deducted from the respective income on the credit side of Profit & Loss Account and shown as a current liability in the Balance Sheet.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Adjustment done in only one account or incorrect classification.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Wrongly treated as an asset or completely omitted.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Accurate calculation and dual placement of depreciation on fixed assets.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Debited to Profit & Loss Account and correctly deducted from the respective fixed asset in the Balance Sheet.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Shown in only one place or calculation error made with correct placement.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Depreciation ignored completely.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Comprehensive treatment of further bad debts, new provision for doubtful debts, and old provision in Profit & Loss Account and Balance Sheet.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Further bad debts and new provision deducted from debtors, and net provision debited to P&L (with correct adjustment of old provision).
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Arithmetic error or incorrect adjustment of old provision while placement is correct.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: No provision or bad debts adjustment shown.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Correct calculation and accounting treatment of provision for discount on debtors.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Calculated on good debtors (after deducting further bad debts and new provision), debited to P&L, and deducted from debtors in Balance Sheet.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Calculated on gross debtors or shown in only one statement.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Completely ignored.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Accurate calculation of manager's commission before or after charging such commission and its presentation.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct formula applied (profit before/after commission), debited to P&L Account, and shown as an outstanding liability in the Balance Sheet.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Formula applied incorrectly or shown only as an expense without creating the liability.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Manager's commission ignored.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Accounting treatment of abnormal loss of goods by fire or accident when insured or uninsured.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Full loss credited to Trading Account, insurance claim recognized as an asset, and uninsured loss debited to Profit & Loss Account.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Partial accounting recorded or missing one of the three required components.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: No record of abnormal loss or insurance claim.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Calculation of Interest on Drawings using the average period method under different withdrawal patterns.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct formula, appropriate average time period, and accurate final calculation.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct formula used or correct average period identified, but calculation arithmetic error.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect formula and completely erroneous calculation without logical steps.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Preparation of Profit and Loss Appropriation Account incorporating interest on capital, interest on drawings, and partner's salary.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct debit and credit entries, proper balancing, and accurate transfer of divisible profit.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Some correct items included with minor posting or calculation errors in subsidiary workings.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Major conceptual errors, wrong side posting, or completely blank/irrelevant format.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Accounting treatment and calculation of interest on partner's loan when there is an absence of a partnership deed.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Application of 6% p.a. statutory rate in the absence of agreement and correct journal/ledger entry.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Identified that interest is a charge against profit but used an incorrect interest rate.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Treated loan interest as an appropriation of profit or ignored the provision entirely.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Solution of problems involving guarantee of minimum profit to a partner by remaining partners.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurate distribution of profits as per profit-sharing ratio and precise adjustment of deficiency by guaranteeing partners.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct profit-sharing distribution but failure to correctly adjust the guaranteed deficiency amount.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Ignored the guarantee condition or incorrect adjustment across all partners.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Distinction and preparation of Partners' Capital Accounts under Fixed Capital Method and Fluctuating Capital Method.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Proper maintenance of both Capital and Current accounts under fixed method, or single capital account under fluctuating method with correct balances.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct entries recorded but mixed up items between Capital and Current accounts.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Random entries placed without understanding the difference between fixed and fluctuating methods.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Rectification of past adjustments through a single adjustment entry for omission of interest on capital or drawings.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurate analytical table, correct net effect calculation, and precise passing of the single adjustment journal entry with narration.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Analytical table constructed with minor calculation errors leading to a partially incorrect journal entry.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: No analytical table shown and incorrect journal entry without logical reconciliation.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Calculation of Interest on Capital considering additional capital introduced and withdrawals made during the accounting year.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Time-apportioned calculation for opening capital, additional capital, and withdrawals with exact final interest amounts.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Calculated interest only on opening capital while ignoring time-weighting for additional capital.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Direct percentage applied to closing capital or random figures used.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Calculation of partner's commission 'before charging such commission' versus 'after charging such commission'.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct application of the respective formulas (Rate/100 vs Rate/(100 + Rate)) and accurate final figure.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Identified the correct commission condition but used the wrong formula fraction.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Ignored the distinction between before and after charging formulas.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Differentiation and treatment of rent paid to a partner as a charge against profit versus appropriation of profit.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly debited to Profit and Loss Account (not P&L Appropriation) and proper treatment in final accounts.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Recognized rent as an expense but incorrectly debited it to P&L Appropriation Account.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Treated partner's rent as a partner's drawing or ignored it.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Identification of rules applicable in the absence of a Partnership Deed as per the Indian Partnership Act, 1932.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct listing and explanation of all default provisions (no interest on capital/drawings, equal profit sharing, 6% interest on loan, no salary).
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Mentioned some correct provisions but missed key rules like interest on loan or profit sharing ratio.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect provisions stated contrary to the Indian Partnership Act, 1932.

subject: Accountancy
chapter: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm: Admission of a Partner
criteria: Calculation of new profit sharing ratio and sacrificing ratio based on given conditions.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct calculation of both new profit sharing ratio and individual sacrificing ratios with proper working notes.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct sacrificing ratio formula applied but minor arithmetic error in final ratio calculation.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect formula used or completely wrong calculations without working notes.

subject: Accountancy
chapter: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm: Admission of a Partner
criteria: Treatment and journal entries for premium for goodwill brought in cash by the incoming partner.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct journal entry for bringing in cash and correct entry for distribution of premium to sacrificing partners in sacrificing ratio.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct entry for receipt of cash/goodwill but incorrect debit/credit or incorrect ratio for distribution.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: No entries passed or completely incorrect ledger accounts and accounts debited/credited.

subject: Accountancy
chapter: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm: Admission of a Partner
criteria: Treatment of goodwill when the incoming partner is unable to bring their share of goodwill in cash.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct debiting of incoming partner's current account and crediting sacrificing partners' capital accounts in sacrificing ratio.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Used capital account instead of current account or incorrect amount calculated for the share of goodwill.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Failed to account for unbrought goodwill or passed arbitrary entries without logical backing.

subject: Accountancy
chapter: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm: Admission of a Partner
criteria: Preparation of Revaluation Account for revaluation of assets and reassessment of liabilities.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: All increases/decreases in assets and liabilities correctly recorded with correct profit or loss transferred to old partners' capital accounts in old ratio.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Some adjustments recorded correctly while one or two items are posted on the wrong side or omitted.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Revaluation account is fundamentally incorrect or profit/loss distributed in new/sacrificing ratio instead of old ratio.

subject: Accountancy
chapter: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm: Admission of a Partner
criteria: Treatment of accumulated profits, reserves, and losses appearing in the balance sheet.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct distribution of general reserve, profit and loss account credit/debit balances, and specific reserves among old partners in old ratio.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Distributed some reserves but missed others, or distributed in incorrect ratio.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Ignored accumulated reserves or distributed them among all partners including the new partner.

subject: Accountancy
chapter: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm: Admission of a Partner
criteria: Calculation and accounting treatment of hidden goodwill based on capital contribution and profit share.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct determination of total capital of the firm, comparison with combined adjusted capital, accurate hidden goodwill calculation, and correct journal entries.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct total capital calculated but error made in calculating the new partner's share or adjusting existing partners.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Failed to identify hidden goodwill concept or incorrect formula used for total capital estimation.

subject: Accountancy
chapter: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm: Admission of a Partner
criteria: Preparation of Partners' Capital Accounts incorporating all adjustments (goodwill, revaluation, reserves, and capital brought in).

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: All balances brought down, revaluation profit/loss, reserves, premium for goodwill, and capital contributions correctly posted with accurate closing balances.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Most adjustments correct with minor posting errors leading to incorrect closing capital balances.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Capital accounts lack multiple major adjustments or have fundamental debit/credit reversals.

subject: Accountancy
chapter: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm: Admission of a Partner
criteria: Adjustment of capitals of existing partners on the basis of the new partner's capital.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Total capital calculated based on new partner's capital and share, individual new capitals determined correctly, and differences adjusted via cash or current accounts as specified.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Total capital calculated correctly but adjustment method (cash vs current account) misapplied or ignored.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Did not calculate proportionate capital basis or completely erroneous capital adjustments.

subject: Accountancy
chapter: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm: Admission of a Partner
criteria: Adjustment of existing partner's capital through cash or current accounts to maintain a specific total capital or proportionate balance.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Exact calculation of surplus or deficit in existing partners' capitals and correct journal entries/ledger postings using cash/bank or current accounts.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct surplus/deficit identified but posted to wrong accounts (e.g., using cash instead of current account when specified).
scoring_breakdown.Zero: No capital adjustment calculations provided or arbitrary figures used.

subject: Accountancy
chapter: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm: Admission of a Partner
criteria: Preparation of Revaluation Account, Partners' Capital Accounts, and the revised Balance Sheet in a comprehensive full-length problem.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Revaluation account, capital accounts, and final balance sheet are fully correct, balanced, and match trial balance principles with proper working notes.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Revaluation and capital accounts solved correctly, but balance sheet does not tally due to minor carry-forward posting omissions.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Major accounts are incorrect, missing, or balance sheet does not reflect admitted partner adjustments.

subject: Accountancy
chapter: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm: Retirement/Death of a Partner
criteria: Calculation of new profit-sharing ratio and gaining ratio

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct calculation of both new profit-sharing ratio and gaining ratio with clear steps and working notes.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct formula used or right calculation of either new ratio or gaining ratio with minor errors.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect formulas and wrong calculations throughout.

subject: Accountancy
chapter: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm: Retirement/Death of a Partner
criteria: Accounting treatment of goodwill through capital accounts

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct journal entry passing remaining partners' capital accounts in gaining ratio and retiring partner's capital account in sacrifice ratio.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct accounts debited and credited but incorrect ratio used for the adjustment.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect journal entry or no attempt made.

subject: Accountancy
chapter: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm: Retirement/Death of a Partner
criteria: Preparation of Revaluation Account on retirement or death

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: All asset increases/decreases and liability increases/decreases correctly posted with correct profit or loss transferred to capital accounts.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Most entries correct with minor classification or calculation errors in profit/loss distribution.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Major conceptual errors or completely blank revaluation account.

subject: Accountancy
chapter: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm: Retirement/Death of a Partner
criteria: Distribution of accumulated profits, reserves, and losses among all partners

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct distribution of general reserve, profit and loss account balance, and fictitious assets in old profit-sharing ratio.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Distribution done but incorrect ratio applied or some items missed.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect treatment or ignored completely.

subject: Accountancy
chapter: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm: Retirement/Death of a Partner
criteria: Computation of deceased partner's share of profit up to the date of death

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurate calculation using time basis or sales/turnover basis with correct passing of Profit and Loss Suspense Account entry.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct method identified but computational error in time period or sales proportion.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Wrong basis used or calculation missing entirely.

subject: Accountancy
chapter: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm: Retirement/Death of a Partner
criteria: Preparation of Retiring Partner's Loan Account with interest calculations

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct opening balance, interest calculation, installment payments, and closing balance over the specified period.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Loan account opened correctly but interest or installment calculation contains minor errors.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect format or missing loan account.

subject: Accountancy
chapter: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm: Retirement/Death of a Partner
criteria: Adjustment of capitals of continuing partners in proportion to their new profit-sharing ratio

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct determination of new capitals, comparison with adjusted capital balances, and proper recording of excess or deficit via current accounts or cash.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct new capitals calculated but adjustment mechanism flawed.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect capital adjustment logic or unattempted.

subject: Accountancy
chapter: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm: Retirement/Death of a Partner
criteria: Accounting treatment of Joint Life Policy (JLP) surrender value or claim amount

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly credited to all partners' capital accounts in old ratio upon surrender or death of a partner.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct entry for policy value but credited or debited in wrong ratio.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect accounting treatment.

subject: Accountancy
chapter: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm: Retirement/Death of a Partner
criteria: Preparation of Retiring Partner's Capital Account and determination of final settlement amount

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: All adjustments including share of profit, reserves, goodwill, revaluation, and drawings correctly posted and final balance transferred to loan or cash/bank correctly.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Most adjustments correct with one or two missing items or totaling errors.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Capital account unorganized or major entries omitted.

subject: Accountancy
chapter: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm: Retirement/Death of a Partner
criteria: Preparation of the Balance Sheet of the reconstituted firm after retirement or death

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Assets and liabilities shown at revised values, capital accounts updated with new balances, and balance sheet tallied correctly.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Balance sheet prepared with tallying achieved by force or minor posting errors from capital/revaluation accounts.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Does not tally due to conceptual errors or major omissions.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Preparation of Realization Account and transfer of book values of assets and liabilities

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly transfers all sundry assets (except cash/bank, fictitious assets, accumulated losses/profits) to debit side and external liabilities/provisions to credit side at book values.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Transfers most assets and liabilities correctly, with minor omission or incorrect inclusion of cash/bank or partner's loan.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Fails to prepare the Realization Account or completely scrambles the transfer of assets and liabilities.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Accounting treatment for realization of assets and settlement of liabilities

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurately records sale of assets (Bank/Cash A/c Dr. to Realization A/c) and payment of liabilities (Realization A/c Dr. to Bank/Cash A/c) with correct amounts.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Records entries with correct logic but minor arithmetic errors or slight misclassification in asset realization values.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect entries for asset realization and liability payment without understanding the Realization Account mechanism.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Treatment of unrecorded assets and unrecorded liabilities

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly credits Realization Account for unrecorded assets realized and debits Realization Account for unrecorded liabilities paid.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Treats either unrecorded asset or unrecorded liability correctly but misses the other or enters on the wrong side.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Ignores unrecorded items entirely or records them in capital accounts instead of Realization Account.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Treatment of Realization Expenses (Dissolution Expenses) borne or paid by firm/partner

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Applies correct rule based on whether expenses are borne and paid by the firm or a partner (Realization A/c Dr. or Partner's Capital A/c Dr.).
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Identifies the correct account to debit but makes a minor error in matching who bears vs. who pays.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrectly debits or credits realization expenses without regard to the partnership agreement or terms of dissolution.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Partner taking over an asset or undertaking to pay a liability

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly debits Partner's Capital Account and credits Realization Account for asset taken over, and debits Realization Account and credits Partner's Capital Account for liability undertaken.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Gets the debit/credit direction correct for one transaction (asset or liability) but reverses or misses the other.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Records partner transactions in the Balance Sheet or ignores the partner's takeover entry.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Calculation and distribution of Realization Profit or Loss

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurately balances Realization Account, calculates profit/loss correctly, and distributes it among partners in their profit-sharing ratio.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correctly balances the account but distributes profit/loss in an incorrect ratio or makes a minor calculation error.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Fails to close the Realization Account or omits transferring profit/loss to capital accounts.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Treatment of Partner's Loan to the firm

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Properly closes Partner's Loan Account by paying through Bank/Cash A/c (Partner's Loan A/c Dr. to Bank A/c) without routing through Realization Account.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Transfers partner's loan to Realization Account instead of paying it directly, or vice-versa with minor debit/credit error.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Fails to settle partner's loan or treats it as an external liability in the Realization Account.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Preparation of Partner's Capital Accounts to determine final balances

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurately incorporates opening balances, reserves, accumulated profits/losses, realization profit/loss, asset/liability takeovers, and computes final cash settlement figures.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Includes most components correctly but misses reserves, accumulated profits, or minor posting errors.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incomplete capital accounts with incorrect adjustments for realization results.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Preparation of Bank/Cash Account as the final check of dissolution accounting

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly records opening cash/bank balance, inflows from asset realization, and outflows for liability payments, realization expenses, and final partner settlements, resulting in exact tally.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Includes major inflows and outflows but the account fails to tally due to minor omissions or transposition errors.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Omits Bank/Cash account entirely or includes improper items.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Journal entries for the closure of books on dissolution

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Passes systematic, chronologically correct journal entries for asset transfers, realizations, expense payments, liability settlements, and final capital distributions.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Passes most journal entries correctly with proper narrations, but misses 1-2 closing entries or narrates incorrectly.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Fails to provide journal entries or writes random accounts without debit/credit balance compliance.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Pass correct journal entries for the issue of shares at par and at a premium across application, allotment, and call stages.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: All journal entries passed with correct accounts, amounts, dates/stages, and mandatory narrations.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct entries for application and allotment stages, but calculation or posting errors in call stages or missing narrations.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect accounts debited or credited, or major conceptual errors in recording share issue stages.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Record journal entries for Calls-in-Arrears and Calls-in-Advance with proper account classifications.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurate calculation and journaling of calls-in-arrears (deducted from called-up capital) and calls-in-advance (credited as liability).
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct identification of arrears or advance amounts, but incorrect debit/credit treatment in ledger or journal.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Failure to account for arrears or advance or total confusion between the two concepts.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Pass necessary journal entries for the forfeiture of shares originally issued at par upon non-payment of calls.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Share Capital Account debited with called-up amount, Forfeited Shares Account credited with amount received, and unpaid calls accounts credited correctly.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct debit to Share Capital, but errors in calculating the exact amount received or unpaid call balances.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect reversal of share capital or failure to credit forfeiture and call-in-arrears properly.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Pass journal entries for the forfeiture of shares originally issued at a premium where the premium amount has not been received.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Securities Premium Reserve debited if unpaid, Share Capital debited with called-up value, and respective unpaid call/allotment accounts credited.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Forfeiture entry passed for share capital and calls, but Securities Premium Reserve is either omitted from debit or wrongly treated when unpaid.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Complete disregard of Securities Premium treatment upon forfeiture.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Record journal entries for the reissue of forfeited shares at par, at a premium, or at a discount (within permissible limits).

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct bank entry for amount realized, debit to Forfeited Shares Account for discount on reissue (if any), and credit to Share Capital.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct bank entry, but incorrect calculation of the reissue discount or mismatch in share capital credited.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect handling of reissue proceeds or failure to account for forfeited shares balance.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Calculate and pass the journal entry to transfer the balance of the Forfeited Shares Account to Capital Reserve upon complete reissue.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Proportionate or total gain on reissue calculated accurately and transferred via journal entry to Capital Reserve Account.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct calculation for full reissue, but arithmetic error or incorrect proportion applied for partial reissue.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: No transfer to Capital Reserve or arbitrary amount used without calculation.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Solve pro-rata allotment problems involving the adjustment of excess application money towards allotment and subsequent calls.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurate table/working notes prepared showing categories, shares applied vs allotted, excess application money adjusted, and refunds.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct working notes for excess application money at allotment stage, but failure to handle adjustments for further calls.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Working notes missing or major calculation errors in pro-rata table affecting subsequent journal entries.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Prepare the Share Capital disclosure in the Balance Sheet of a company as per Schedule III of the Companies Act, 2013.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Proper presentation under Equity and Liabilities showing Authorized, Issued, Subscribed and Fully Paid-up/Subscribed but not fully paid-up capital, with Notes to Accounts.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct main head and sub-heads in Balance Sheet, but errors or omissions in Notes to Accounts calculations (e.g., calls-in-arrears deduction).
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect format, mixing of capital types, or failure to follow Schedule III guidelines.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Pass journal entries for the issue of shares for consideration other than cash to vendors or promoters.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct entries for purchase of assets/business, followed by issue of shares at par, premium, or discount to vendors with proper narration.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct asset purchase entry, but calculation or journaling error in issuing shares to the vendor (e.g., ignoring goodwill or capital reserve).
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Failure to record asset acquisition or incorrect share distribution to vendors.

subject: Accounting for Share Capital
criteria: Handle cases of over-subscription where excess application money is either refunded or adjusted pro-rata.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurate journal entries reflecting refund of rejected applications and adjustment of accepted excess money towards allotment.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct identification of over-subscription units, but error in splitting the refund versus adjustment amounts.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect bank or application account balances with no adjustment for excess subscriptions.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Pass journal entries for the issue of debentures at par, at premium, and at discount along with proper narration.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct accounts debited and credited with accurate amounts and complete narration.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct entries passed but minor error in narration or amount computation.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect accounts or major conceptual error in journalizing issue of debentures.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Record journal entries for the issue of debentures redeemable at a premium, incorporating the loss on issue of debentures.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct recognition of 'Loss on Issue of Debentures Account' and 'Premium on Redemption of Debentures Account' with correct values.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: One of the two accounts correctly identified or computational error in amount.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Failure to record the liability for premium on redemption or missing entry entirely.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Pass necessary journal entries for the issue of debentures as collateral security under both methods.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct entry for creating collateral security (either no entry or debiting Debenture Suspense A/c) with clear explanation in notes to accounts.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct identification of collateral method but partial error in journal posting.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect handling of collateral security or treating it as a normal issue.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Calculate and record journal entries for interest on debentures, tax deduction at source (TDS), and transfer to statement of profit and loss.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurate calculation of interest, proper accounting for TDS payable, and correct transfer to Statement of Profit and Loss.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct interest amount calculated but errors in TDS accounting or transfer entry.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect interest calculation or missing ledger postings.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Determine the required percentage and amount for Debenture Redemption Reserve (DRR) as per Companies Act guidelines and pass necessary entries.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct application of DRR rules (e.g., 10% for eligible companies) and accurate transfer from Surplus (Statement of Profit and Loss) to DRR.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct concept understood but minor calculation error in DRR amount.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Failure to apply statutory DRR requirements or incorrect accounting treatment.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Fulfill the statutory investment requirement by investing in specified securities (Debenture Redemption Investment / DRI) prior to redemption.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct calculation of 15% DRI requirement and accurate journal entries for investment purchase and encashment.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct investment percentage applied but errors in recording investment realization.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Missing DRI entries or incorrect investment threshold used.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Pass journal entries for redemption of debentures by payment out of capital or profits at maturity.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurate due date entry for redemption and final payment entry to debentureholders.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct redemption due entry but error in final bank payment entry.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect accounts used for redemption or missing entries.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Record journal entries for redemption of debentures by purchase in the open market (cum-interest and ex-interest purchase).

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurate separation of interest and principal components for open market purchase and cancellation of own debentures.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct purchase entry made but confusion between cum-interest and ex-interest valuation.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect treatment of open market purchase or failure to cancel own debentures.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Pass journal entries for the redemption of debentures by conversion into equity shares or new debentures.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct determination of conversion ratio, issue price of shares/new debentures, and accurate closing entry.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct redemption due entry but arithmetic error in share allotment calculation.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Major conceptual error in handling conversion.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Prepare ledger accounts such as Loss on Issue of Debentures Account or Premium on Redemption of Debentures Account over multiple financial years.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct posting of opening/closing balances, proper writing off annually, and accurate balancing.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct postings with minor balancing or writing-off calculation error.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect ledger format or failure to write off loss over the tenure.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Correct classification and sub-head presentation of Share Capital under Equity and Liabilities in the Balance Sheet as per Schedule III.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly states Authorised, Issued, Subscribed and Paid-up capital, with calls-in-arrears deducted correctly.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Identifies the major head (Share Capital) and some sub-heads correctly but misses calls-in-arrears adjustment.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Fails to classify under Equity and Liabilities or lists incorrect major heads.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Accurate identification and categorization of Reserves and Surplus under Equity and Liabilities.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly lists Capital Reserve, Securities Premium, General Reserve, and Surplus (Balance in Statement of Profit and Loss).
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Includes some correct reserves but misses the negative balance treatment of Statement of Profit and Loss.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Places reserves under liability sub-heads or assets.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Correct classification of Non-Current Liabilities (Long-Term Borrowings, Long-Term Provisions, etc.) as per Schedule III.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Properly distinguishes between long-term borrowings (debentures, term loans) and provisions, correctly placing them under Non-Current Liabilities.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Identifies Non-Current Liabilities correctly but misclassifies long-term provisions as current.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Fails to identify the major head or lists current liabilities under non-current.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Accurate grouping and sub-classification of Current Liabilities (Short-Term Borrowings, Trade Payables, Other Current Liabilities, Short-Term Provisions).

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly details Trade Payables (Sundry creditors, Bills payable) and short-term provisions (Provision for tax).
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Groups current liabilities under the correct major head but misallocates specific sub-items.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Omits current liabilities or classifies long-term debts under current liabilities incorrectly.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Accurate classification of Non-Current Assets (Property, Plant and Equipment and Intangible Assets).

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly distinguishes tangible assets (land, building, machinery) and intangible assets (goodwill, patents) with appropriate notes.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Lists tangible and intangible assets correctly under Non-Current Assets but omits accumulated depreciation adjustment.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Fails to classify assets under Non-Current Assets or mixes current and non-current items.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Correct presentation of Current Assets (Inventories, Trade Receivables, Cash and Cash Equivalents, Short-Term Loans and Advances).

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurately categorizes inventories, trade receivables (with provision for doubtful debts shown correctly), and cash/bank balances.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Identifies the major head of Current Assets but misplaces items like prepaid expenses or short-term loans.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrectly classifies long-term investments or fixed assets under current assets.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Format and structure of the Statement of Profit and Loss showing Revenue from Operations and Other Income.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly segregates revenue from operations (sale of products/services) and other incomes (interest, dividend received).
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Includes revenue items but incorrectly classifies operating revenue as other income.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Fails to follow the vertical format of the Statement of Profit and Loss as per Schedule III.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Accurate grouping of expenses in the Statement of Profit and Loss (Cost of Materials Consumed, Employee Benefits Expense, Finance Costs, Depreciation).

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Properly classifies finance costs (interest on debentures/loans) and employee benefit expenses (salaries, staff welfare).
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Includes major expense items but misallocates financing costs or depreciation.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Omits major expense heads or aggregates expenses arbitrarily without Schedule III headings.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Calculation and reporting of Net Profit Before Tax and Tax Expense in the Statement of Profit and Loss.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly derives total revenue minus total expenses before tax, subtracts applicable tax expense, and arrives at Profit After Tax.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Calculates profit before tax correctly but makes arithmetic or tax computation errors.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Fails to compute profit before/after tax or ignores the tax line item.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Disclosure of Contingent Liabilities and Commitments in the Notes to Accounts of a company's financial statements.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly identifies items like claims against the company not acknowledged as debt, guarantees, and uncalled liability on shares.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Mentions contingent liabilities conceptually but fails to state them properly in Notes to Accounts format.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Treats contingent liabilities as actual balance sheet liabilities or omits them entirely.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Correct identification and classification of items under major heads and sub-heads in the Balance Sheet as per Schedule III of the Companies Act, 2013.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct identification of major head, sub-head, and specific item name.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct major head identified but incorrect sub-head or vice versa.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect classification or missing response.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Accurate calculation of Current Ratio and Quick Ratio with proper formula application and standard unit representation.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct formula stated, correct values substituted, and accurate final ratio with standard unit (e.g., 2:1).
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct formula and substitution shown but minor arithmetic error in final answer.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect formula used or completely wrong values substituted.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Preparation and interpretation of Comparative Statement of Profit and Loss showing absolute change and percentage change.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurate absolute change, correct percentage change calculation, and adherence to the prescribed format.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct absolute change calculation but error in percentage change computation.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect values or completely wrong format used.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Preparation of Common Size Balance Sheet showing the percentage of each item to Total Assets or Equity and Liabilities.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct percentages calculated up to two decimal places for all items against the correct base total.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct base used but calculation error in a few individual item percentages.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect base used or major calculation errors throughout.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Computation of Debt-Equity Ratio and Proprietary Ratio with accurate component extraction from the financial statements.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct computation of long-term debts/shareholders' funds and accurate final ratio.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct components identified but incorrect arithmetic or formula application.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Wrong components included in Debt or Equity computation.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Analysis and calculation of Trade Receivables Turnover Ratio and Average Collection Period.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurate Net Credit Sales, Average Trade Receivables, correct turnover ratio, and collection period in days/months.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct turnover ratio calculated but failed to compute or incorrectly computed collection period.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect formula or wrong figures used for credit sales and receivables.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Calculation of Gross Profit Ratio and Operating Ratio from given financial statements.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct formula, accurate Gross Profit/Operating Cost computation, and percentage expressed correctly.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct components identified with minor calculation error in numerator or denominator.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect formula or failure to include operating expense components correctly.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Evaluation of limitations and significance of Financial Statement Analysis in business decision making.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Clear explanation covering qualitative aspects ignored, price level changes not considered, and subjective judgments.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Partially explained limitations with missing contextual depth or incomplete points.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Irrelevant, vague, or incorrect explanation.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Computation of Return on Investment (ROI) / Return on Capital Employed (ROCE) with proper formula steps.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurate calculation of Net Profit before Interest and Tax (PBIT) and Capital Employed with correct percentage result.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct capital employed computed but error in PBIT calculation or vice versa.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect formula or wrong components used for capital employed.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Analysis of Inventory Turnover Ratio and Working Capital Turnover Ratio with proper interpretation.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurate Cost of Revenue from Operations / Revenue from Operations, average inventory/working capital, and correct ratios.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct inventory or working capital computed but turnover formula applied incorrectly.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Completely incorrect formula and calculation.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Correct calculation and formula application of Current Ratio.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct formula, correct classification of current assets/liabilities, and accurate final ratio with proper unit (e.g., 2:1).
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct formula stated and some current assets/liabilities correctly identified, but calculation or final ratio incorrect.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect formula and wrong values used.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Accurate computation of Liquid/Quick Ratio considering inventory and prepaid expenses exclusion.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct formula (Liquid Assets / Current Liabilities), proper exclusion of inventory/prepaid expenses, and accurate final value.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Formula used correctly but minor error in excluding inventory or calculation mistake.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Did not exclude inventory or used incorrect formula.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Proper determination of long-term debts and shareholders' funds for Debt-Equity Ratio.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurately computes Long-Term Debts and Shareholders' Funds with correct formula and proportion format.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct formula stated but misclassification of one component (e.g., including short-term borrowings in debt).
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect formula and completely wrong components.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Calculation of Proprietary Ratio showing proportion of total assets financed by proprietors.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct formula (Shareholders' Funds / Total Assets), accurate calculation, and expressed as a ratio or percentage.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct formula written, but calculation error in total assets or shareholders' funds.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect formula used.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Computation of Gross Profit Ratio from Revenue from Operations and Cost of Revenue from Operations.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct formula ((Gross Profit / Revenue from Operations) * 100), accurate GP computation, and percentage output.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct formula but error in calculating Gross Profit or Net Revenue from Operations.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect formula or major calculation errors.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Accurate calculation of Net Profit Ratio indicating overall profitability.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct formula ((Net Profit / Revenue from Operations) * 100), proper inclusion of operating/non-operating items, and correct percentage.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Formula stated correctly, but error in net profit figure or revenue figure.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect formula used.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Computation of Inventory Turnover Ratio measuring inventory management efficiency.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct formula (Cost of Revenue from Operations / Average Inventory), accurate average inventory and cost calculation, expressed in times.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct formula used, but either Cost of Goods Sold or Average Inventory calculated incorrectly.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Used closing inventory instead of average inventory or wrong formula.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Evaluation of Trade Receivables Turnover Ratio and average collection period.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct formula (Net Credit Sales / Average Trade Receivables), correct average trade receivables, and unit in 'times'.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Formula correct, but total sales used instead of credit sales or incorrect average calculation.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect formula or arbitrary values.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Calculation of Interest Coverage Ratio assessing ability to pay interest on long-term debt.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct formula (Net Profit before Interest and Tax / Interest on Long-term Debts), accurate profit adjustment, unit in 'times'.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Formula correct, but failed to add back interest and tax to net profit correctly.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Used profit after tax without adjustment or wrong formula.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Computation of Operating Ratio to measure operational efficiency and cost structure.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correct formula (((Cost of Revenue from Operations + Operating Expenses) / Revenue from Operations) * 100), accurate summation, and percentage output.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Correct formula, but classification error between operating and non-operating expenses.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect formula or wrong components.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Calculation of Net Profit Before Tax and Extraordinary Items

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly adds proposed dividend, transfer to reserves, provision for tax, and deducts refund of tax / extraordinary items.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Includes some adjustments correctly but misses or wrongly treats provisions or reserves.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Takes net profit as given without any adjustments or uses incorrect starting figures.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Adjustment for Non-Cash and Non-Operating Expenses

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly adds back depreciation, amortization of intangible assets, goodwill written off, and interest on borrowings.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Adds some non-cash items but misses amortization or interest expenses.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Fails to add back any non-cash or non-operating expenses.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Adjustment for Non-Cash and Non-Operating Incomes

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly deducts non-operating incomes such as interest received, dividend received, and gain on sale of fixed assets.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Deducts some operating incomes incorrectly or misses one of the investment incomes.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Does not deduct non-operating incomes from the operating profit calculation.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Operating Profit Before Working Capital Changes

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurately computes operating profit after combining net profit before tax and non-cash/non-operating adjustments.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Minor arithmetic error or one incorrect sign in addition/subtraction of adjustments.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Fails to arrive at operating profit before working capital changes due to major conceptual errors.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Adjustment for Changes in Working Capital (Current Assets and Current Liabilities)

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly adds decrease in current assets/increase in current liabilities and deducts increase in current assets/decrease in current liabilities.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Reverses the direction of adjustments for some current assets or current liabilities.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Ignores working capital changes completely or applies random signs.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Cash Flow from Operating Activities (CFOA) Final Computation

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly adjusts operating profit by working capital changes and deducts income tax paid (net of refund) to arrive at final CFOA.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Arithmetic mistakes in final summation or omission of tax paid deduction.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect layout or entirely wrong final operating cash flow figure.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Cash Flow from Investing Activities - Fixed Assets and Investments

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly accounts for purchase and sale of tangible/intangible fixed assets (using ledger accounts where required) and investments.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Treats asset sale/purchase partially or makes an error in calculating book value/accumulated depreciation.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Omits investing activities or treats operating items under investing.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Cash Flow from Investing Activities - Investment Incomes

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly includes interest received and dividend received as positive cash inflows under investing activities.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Places investment income under operating activities instead of investing activities.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Ignores investment incomes entirely.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Cash Flow from Financing Activities - Share Capital and Borrowings

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurately records proceeds from issue of shares/debentures, redemption of debentures, and repayment/raising of bank loans.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Misses either the inflow from issue or outflow from redemption.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect classification of financing items.

subject: Accountancy
criteria: Cash Flow from Financing Activities - Dividends and Interest Paid

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly treats payment of interim dividend, proposed dividend of previous year, and interest on borrowings as financing outflows.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Omits interest paid or treats proposed dividend incorrectly.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Fails to include financial charges and dividends under financing activities.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Explain the concept of economic and non-economic activities with suitable examples.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurate distinction with clear examples of both economic and non-economic activities.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Distinction is partially clear or examples are missing or incorrect.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect or irrelevant explanation.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Differentiate between business, profession, and employment on the basis of mode of establishment, nature of work, and reward.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly differentiates all three based on specified parameters.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Differentiates based on only one or two parameters, or contains minor errors.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Fails to differentiate correctly.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Classify business activities into industry and commerce with examples.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurate classification of industry and commerce with appropriate sub-divisions and examples.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Broadly classifies but misses sub-divisions or examples.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect classification.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Explain the various types of industries (primary, secondary, and tertiary) with examples.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Clear explanation of primary, secondary, and tertiary industries along with relevant examples.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Explains some categories or lacks proper examples.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect or missing explanation.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Describe the components of commerce: trade and auxiliaries to trade.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Detailed description of trade types and at least 3-4 auxiliaries like transport, banking, and warehousing.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Mentions trade or auxiliaries vaguely without sufficient detail.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect or no relevant details provided.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Discuss the multiple objectives of a business, distinguishing between economic and social objectives.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Comprehensive coverage of both economic and social objectives with accurate explanations.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Mentions only economic objectives or provides superficial social objectives.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Irrelevant response.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Explain the nature and causes of business risks.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Defines business risk and explains natural, human, economic, and other causes with examples.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Explains risks but misses key causes or lacks examples.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect understanding of business risk.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Analyze the role of profit in business.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Clear explanation of why profit is essential for survival, growth, efficiency, and risk-bearing.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: States profit is important for earning money only, lacking conceptual depth.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect explanation.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Differentiate between internal trade and external trade including import, export, and entrepot.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurately distinguishes between internal and external trade and includes correct definitions for import, export, and entrepot.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Differentiates internal and external trade but misses external sub-types.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect or confused definitions.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Discuss the historical background of trade and commerce in ancient India, including the role of silk routes and maritime trade.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Well-articulated discussion on ancient trade routes, major trade centers, and maritime networks as per NCERT text.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Vague references to ancient trade without specifics.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Irrelevant or incorrect historical context.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Explains the key features, merits, and limitations of Sole Proprietorship with appropriate business examples.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Clearly explains at least 3 features, 2 merits, and 2 limitations with a relevant example.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Explains some features or merits/limitations but lacks examples or complete explanation.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect or irrelevant explanation of sole proprietorship.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Describes the concept, governing law, membership, and liability structure of Joint Hindu Family Business.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurately describes Hindu Succession Act, Karta's role, coparceners, and unlimited liability of Karta.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Mentions Karta or membership rules partially without detailing liability or governing act.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Fails to identify Joint Hindu Family Business characteristics.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Explains the contents of a Partnership Deed and the legal consequences of non-registration of a partnership firm.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Lists at least 4 key clauses of partnership deed and specifies major consequences of non-registration.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Explains partnership deed or non-registration consequences partially.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect or missing information on partnership deed and registration.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Distinguishes between various types of partners based on liability, capital contribution, and active participation.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Correctly differentiates active, sleeping, nominal, and partner by estoppel with accurate liability status.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Differentiates some partner types correctly while confusing others.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Fails to classify different types of partners.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Explains the guiding principles, registration process, and democratic management of Cooperative Societies.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Explains service motive, 'one man one vote' principle, registration under Cooperative Societies Act, and limited liability.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Mentions cooperative principles or registration vaguely without complete operational details.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect explanation of cooperative societies.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Describes the formation stages of a Joint Stock Company including promotion, incorporation, and subscription of capital.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Outlines promotion, incorporation (documentation/ROC), and capital subscription stages sequentially and accurately.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Lists some stages out of order or misses crucial documents like Memorandum of Association.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Does not outline company formation stages correctly.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Analyzes the merits and limitations of Cooperative Societies in the Indian economic framework.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Identifies at least 3 merits (e.g., equality in voting, support to weaker sections) and 3 limitations (e.g., cash trading, government control).
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Mentions a few merits or limitations with limited depth.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Irrelevant or incorrect points on cooperative societies' merits and limitations.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Differentiates between a Private Company and a Public Company across key parameters like membership, transfer of shares, and prospectus.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Provides clear comparison on minimum/maximum members, share transfer restrictions, index of members, and issue of prospectus.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Compares on 1 or 2 parameters correctly but misses vital distinctions like prospectus or share transfer.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect differentiation between private and public companies.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Evaluates the factors influencing the choice of an appropriate form of business organisation.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Examines at least 4 key factors such as nature of business, capital considerations, liability, and managerial ability.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Lists 1-2 factors without adequate explanation of how they influence the choice.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Fails to state relevant factors influencing organisational choice.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Analyzes how capital requirements, scale of operations, and degree of control determine the selection of a business form.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Explains the interrelationship between capital intensity, scale, control retention, and selection of sole proprietorship vs company.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Explains capital or scale briefly without connecting it to the choice of organisation.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect analysis of business form selection criteria.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Explain the meaning and key features of Departmental Undertakings with a suitable Indian example.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Accurate explanation of departmental undertakings as the oldest form of public enterprise, clear listing of at least four major features (such as funding from government treasury and direct control of the ministry), and an appropriate example like Indian Railways.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Mentions the basic definition or some features, but misses out on examples or comprehensive structural details.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Irrelevant or incorrect explanation of the form of organization.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Distinguish between Statutory Corporations and Government Companies based on their formation and ownership.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Precise differentiation showing statutory corporations are formed by a Special Act of Parliament and wholly owned by the state, whereas Government Companies are registered under the Companies Act with a minimum 51% government shareholding.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Distinguishes on only one basis or provides incomplete details regarding formation/ownership.
scoring_breakdown.Zero: Incorrect or confused differentiation between the two forms.

subject: Business Studies
criteria: Explain the key features of Global Enterprises (Multi-National Corporations) as discussed in the NCERT curriculum.

scoring_breakdown.Full Marks: Identifies and explains at least four core features of MNCs such as giant size of capital, centralized control, international operations, and advanced technology.
scoring_breakdown.Partial: Lists one or two features correctly with minimal explanation.
